name: cascade-headless-cloudflare-example
description: Turn build123d Python into STEP/BREP/STL inside a Cloudflare Worker, using cascade-core headless. Every asset is a module of the script (~32-35 MiB of the 64 MiB limit). Two flavors: build123d-lite (default) and verbatim upstream build123d 0.11.1 (--env upstream); --env warm boots the engine at global scope.

scripts.dev:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler dev --env upstream
scripts.deploy:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler deploy --env upstream
scripts.dev:warm: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler dev --env warm
